headlines.description: — Andrew Vaughn had four hits and four RBI, including a two-run double that tied the score in the ninth inning, and the Milwaukee Brewers outlasted the Athletics 15-14 in 12 innings Monday night at Las Vegas Ballpark in a wild game that featured 11...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers outlast A's 15-14 in 12 innings as teams combine for 11 homers and 34 hits in Las Vegas

headlines.description: — Henry Bolte hit his first career home run and the Athletics went deep five more times Tuesday night at Las Vegas Ballpark on the way to a 7-5...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bolte hits 1st MLB homer and A's go deep 5 more times in Las Vegas for 7-5 win over Brewers

headlines.description: — Nick Kurtz hit two homers and drove in five runs, Jeff McNeil also went deep and knocked in four, and the Athletics beat the scuffling Pittsburgh Pirates 11-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Kurtz and Jeff McNeil power the A's to an 11-2 victory over the struggling Pirates

headlines.description: — Brandon Lowe hit a tiebreaking homer in the ninth inning, Bryan Reynolds went deep from both sides of the plate and the Pittsburgh Pirates rallied from an early four-run deficit to beat the Athletics 6-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lowe hits go-ahead homer, Reynolds connects twice as Pirates rally past Athletics for 6-5 victory

headlines.description: — Ryan O'Hearn homered, doubled and singled to finish with a career-high six RBI as the Pittsburgh Pirates romped to a 12-4 victory Wednesday night over the Athletics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan O'Hearn knocks in career-high 6 runs as Pirates roll to 12-4 victory over Athletics
